content: Current token contrast audit: textPrimary 17.10:1 (passes AAA), textSecondary 4.30:1 (FAILS AA 4.5:1 for normal 14px text), textTertiary 1.74:1 (very low, acceptable only for decorative hints), textDisabled 2.14:1 (exempt per WCAG), controlBarBorder vs bgGlass 1.08:1 (essentially invisible, may fail SC 1.4.11 for UI components), accent #2C58FF 3.83:1 (FAILS SC 1.4.11 3:1 for interactive UI), accentegg #66CCFF 11.31:1 (passes all). Reducing bgGlass alpha from 45% to 25% makes minimal difference to contrast ratios.
